transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I can’t shake this feeling that everything bad that’s happened is my fault and that I’m being punished for it. It's just a constant, heavy weight on me, and I don't know what to do anymore.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest or pleasure in things most days for at least two weeks, or has this been coming and going over a longer time?

Yes, it’s been a constant, heavy feeling every single day for the past couple of months, and it's only gotten worse. I’ve completely lost interest in the things I used to love, like my choir, my roses, and tutoring the kids at church. Now, I just look at them and feel absolutely nothing.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression or loss of interest before this one, or is this the first time it has happened?
No, I've never experienced anything like this before in my life. This deep sadness and losing interest in everything only started after my husband passed away. Before that, I was doing okay.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of actively hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel incredibly guilty and like there is just no point to anything anymore, I've never thought about doing something like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration since this started?

Yes, everything has changed drastically. I wake up at three or four in the morning with my heart pounding and can't get back to sleep, and just doing basic chores feels like I'm dragging a hundred pounds. I have to force myself to eat and my mind is so foggy that I can't even follow a TV show or make simple decisions.
When you feel that you are being punished, do you ever hear or see things that other people don’t, or have beliefs that others say are clearly untrue?

No, I don't hear or see things, but I know God is sending me messages through little mishaps, like the cash register coming up short or a hymn book falling, to show He's angry with me. My family tells me I'm wrong, but I am certain my husband's death is my fault and that something terrible is going to happen to my grandkids because of it. I just can't shake this certainty, no matter what anyone says to comfort me.
Do you ever hear voices, see things, or have other experiences that other people do not, in addition to these beliefs that you are being punished?

No, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't really there. It's just those signs I keep noticing, like the register coming up short or the hymn book falling off the pew, which I know are messages of punishment from God. Those are the only experiences I have, but they feel completely real to me.
Have you ever felt so hopeless that you believed your life or the world was not real, or that you were hearing or seeing things others could not?

No, I have never felt like the world isn't real, and I don't hear or see things that aren't there. But I do feel a profound sense of hopelessness and guilt, which has made me certain that God is sending me signs through everyday mishaps to punish me. It's just those little things, like the hymnbook falling, that I know are messages of His anger.
Do you ever hear voices, see things, or have other experiences that other people do not, besides feeling that everyday events are messages from God?

No, I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there. It's just those signs, like the register coming up short or the hymn book falling, which feel completely real and let me know God is punishing me. I don't experience anything else besides that.
Have you ever had beliefs like this before, or felt that everyday events were definite messages from God even when others strongly disagreed?

No, I have never had thoughts or beliefs like this before in my life; they only started a couple of months ago when this deep depression took over. I really do believe these little mishaps are direct signs of God's anger at me, even though my daughter and my pastor disagree and tell me it's not true.
When you notice these signs from God, do you ever hear voices or see things that other people cannot, or is it only the belief that ordinary events have a special meaning?

No, I don't hear any voices or see things that others cannot. It is just this deep, unshakable belief that ordinary events, like a cash register coming up short or a hymn book falling, are direct signs and messages from God showing His anger toward me.
When you feel certain these events are messages from God, do you also ever hear a voice speaking to you or telling you things, even when no one else is around?

No, I don't hear any physical voices speaking to me at all. It's just a deep, unshakable feeling I have when I see things like the register coming up short or a hymn book falling. I just know in my heart that those physical events are signs and messages from God showing His anger.
Have you ever heard voices speaking to you, or felt that someone was controlling your thoughts or actions, even when no one else was there?

No, I have never heard any voices, and I have never felt like anyone else was controlling my thoughts or actions. My thoughts are my own, it's just that I can't escape this heavy guilt and the signs that God is angry with me.

Have you ever had any other fixed beliefs that others say are untrue, or felt that your thoughts were being inserted, taken away, or controlled by someone else? This would help me tell whether the depression is with psychotic features.

No, I have never felt like my thoughts were being inserted, taken away, or controlled by anyone else. I’ve also never had other unusual beliefs in the past, and these convictions about God sending me punishing signs only started recently since I fell into this deep depression.
When you notice these signs from God, do you ever hear a voice speaking to you or telling you things, even when no one else is around?

No, I don't hear anyone talking to me when no one is around. I just interpret those everyday mishaps as silent signs or messages of God's anger. It's not a voice, just a quiet certainty that He is punishing me.
Do you ever hear voices speaking to you, or see things that other people cannot see, even when no one else is around?

No, I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there. My experience is really just limited to these heavy feelings of guilt and the signs of punishment I've described. I don't have those kinds of hallucinations.
Have these beliefs that God is sending you signs ever felt completely fixed even when you try to question them, or do you recognize they might be part of your depression?

They feel completely real and fixed to me, and no matter what anyone says, I truly believe God is sending these signs to punish me. I never had these thoughts before in my life, though; they only started after I sank into this deep, joyless depression following the anniversary of my husband's death.

Have you ever had thoughts that are so strongly held that other people would say they are clearly false, or felt that your guilt and the signs from God were absolutely certain even when you tried to question them?

Yes, I feel absolutely certain about these signs from God, like the register coming up short or the hymn book falling, even though my daughter and pastor tell me it's not true. These thoughts are completely unshakable to me, but I never used to think this way before I fell into this deep depression after my husband's anniversary.
Do you ever hear voices, see things, or have other experiences that other people cannot, or is it only the belief that ordinary events are signs from God?

No, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't really there. It is only the strong belief that ordinary mishaps, like the register coming up short or a hymn book falling, are direct signs from God showing His anger and confirming my guilt.
Do you ever hear voices, see things, or have other experiences that other people cannot, beyond interpreting everyday events as signs from God?

No, I don't hear any voices, see things, or experience anything like that at all. It is strictly just these strong feelings of guilt and my certainty that those everyday mishaps are signs of God's anger.
Have you ever heard voices speaking to you or seen things that other people could not see, especially during this depressive episode?

No, I have not heard any voices or seen things that others couldn't see during this difficult time. My experiences have been completely limited to these heavy feelings of guilt and the signs I mentioned, like the falling hymn book or the cash register coming up short.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things, or had other experiences that other people could not, especially during this depressive episode?

No, I have never heard any voices or seen things that aren't there, even during this terrible depression. I only experience those silent signs, like the falling hymn book, which make me certain of God's anger and my own guilt. These thoughts only started after I fell into this deep, heavy hole after my husband's anniversary.
During this depression, have you ever had any hallucinations or other psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices, seeing things others do not, or feeling that your thoughts are being controlled?

No, I don't hear voices, see things, or feel like my thoughts are controlled at all. However, I do have these strong, unshakeable beliefs that God is sending me signs of His anger, like the falling hymn book, to punish me. These thoughts only started since I fell into this deep depression.
During this depression, have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not see, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else?

No, I have never heard voices, seen things, or felt like my thoughts were being controlled or inserted by anyone else. I don't experience those things at all, but I do still see those silent signs from God, like the hymn book falling or the register coming up short, letting me know He is angry. It's just those heavy warnings that feel so terribly real to me.
Do you ever hear a voice speaking to you, commenting on you, or telling you what to do, even when no one else is around?
No, I have never heard any voices speaking to me, commenting on me, or telling me what to do when I'm alone. I don't hear any sounds like that at all.
Do you ever feel that your thoughts are being broadcast, inserted, taken away, or controlled by someone else, or that people can hear your thoughts?
No, I have never felt like my thoughts were being broadcast, inserted, or controlled by anyone else, and nobody can hear what I'm thinking. I haven't experienced anything like that at all.

During this depression, have you ever had beliefs that are clearly untrue or out of proportion to reality, like being absolutely certain you are being punished by God despite evidence otherwise? Or do you feel your guilt and sadness are severe but still basically realistic?

I am absolutely certain that these signs are real, even though everyone else tells me they aren't. I truly believe God is sending me messages like the falling hymn book to punish me for my past failures as a wife and mother, and it feels completely real to me. I never had any thoughts like this before this deep depression started, but now I just can't shake them.

Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people could not, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else? This helps me tell whether the depression is with psychotic features.

No, I have never heard voices, seen things, or felt like my thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else. However, I do still strongly believe that God is sending me signs and messages through everyday mishaps to punish me.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or inserted by someone else during this depression?

No, I have never heard any voices, seen things, or felt like my thoughts were being controlled or inserted during this depression. But I do feel certain that God is sending me signs of punishment through everyday mishaps like a falling hymn book. These thoughts only began once I fell into this deep, heavy depression.
Do you ever hear voices, see things, or feel that your thoughts are being controlled or inserted by someone else? These symptoms would suggest depression with psychotic features.

No, I don't hear any voices, see things, or feel like my thoughts are being controlled or inserted by anyone else. However, I am absolutely convinced that God is sending me signs and messages through everyday mishaps to show His anger and punish me.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient meets criteria for a depressive episode with persistent depressed mood and marked anhedonia for over 2 months, plus neurovegetative symptoms (early-morning awakening, low energy, reduced appetite, poor concentration, guilt/worthlessness). She also has mood-congruent psychotic symptoms in the form of fixed delusional guilt and punishment beliefs that everyday mishaps are signs from God, occurring only during the depressive episode. No hallucinations or thought-disorder symptoms were reported.
